links.outcome: Safe-response rate under structured red-team attacks versus commercial baselines
links.effect: TLAS-YHCT 100% safe-response rate versus 88.9% and 78.7% for two commercial baselines across 206 attacks
links.quote: A structured red-team of 206 attacks—constructed by domain-expert clinician-educators independent of system developers, scored blind by the same experts under a dual IT-security and clinical-education safety criterion—yielded a 100% safe-response rate versus 88.9% and 78.7% for two commercial baselines.
